nodes.name: Drop-casting and Calcination
nodes.procedure: 0.5 ml of 2 M Mn(NO3)2 was dropped onto a clean FTO-coated glass and then calcined on a hot plate at 250°C in air for 6 h. The resulting electrode was rinsed with Milli-Q ultra-pure water (18.2 MΩ cm at 25°C, Merck Millipore), sonicated for 10 s and then dried at 40°C before measurements.

nodes.name: Spray Pyrolysis
nodes.procedure: An Mn(NO3)2 solution (4 M) was sprayed onto clean QCM quartz crystals (platinum-coated, 10 MHz, Hokuto Denko Corp.), which were then heated at 250°C for 12 h. MnO2 was deposited only within the platinum coated area (defined using a mask) of the QCM quartz crystal.

nodes.characterization_summary: Synchrotron radiation powder XRD patterns after 50 h electrolysis confirm no new crystal phases formed for MnO2 catalyst.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The synchrotron radiation powder X-ray diffraction (Supplementary Fig. 7a) patterns of the catalyst after 50 h of electrolysis at pH 2 with 1.0 M phosphate ion confirmed that no new crystal phases were formed during electrolysis.

nodes.characterization_summary: TEM confirms no significant changes in the morphology of the MnO2 catalyst.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Transmission electron microscopy (Supplementary Fig. 7b,c) also confirmed that there were no significant changes in the morphology of the catalyst.

nodes.characterization_summary: X-ray absorption near edge structure spectroscopy shows minimal change in oxidation state of Mn (less than +0.02) for the catalyst.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The minimal change in the oxidation state of Mn (less than +0.02 ⋅) was observed via X-ray absorption spectroscopy and X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy, indicating that the redeposition process via the Guyard reaction can preserve the oxidation state of Mn species (Supplementary Figs. 8 and 9).

nodes.characterization_summary: XPS shows minimal change in oxidation state of Mn (less than +0.02).

nodes.characterization_summary: Operando resonant Raman shows new peak at 838 cm⁻¹ assigned to Mn⁷⁺ at 1.8 V vs RHE, which disappears within 30 min after phosphate addition.
nodes.evidence_snippet: When the potential was increased to approximately 1.8 V vs. RHE, a new Raman peak assigned to Mn⁷⁺ was observed at 838 cm⁻¹ after 15 min. However, this Raman peak disappeared completely within 30 min of adding phosphate...
